svg.text: ESPACIO Mono Repo Architecture & Workspace Dependency Graph
Unified workspace structure (apps/, packages/, infra/, docs/) with acyclic dependencies and strict role ownership boundaries

g.text: REST, Webhooks, WS, GraphQL, RAG, MCP
GitFlow: main <- qa <- develop <- feature/* | Dual PR Gate (.github/CODEOWNERS)
Root scripts: pnpm dev | build | lint | test | test:e2e | codegen:api | wasm:build
packages/ — Shared Internal Libraries & Spec-Driven Contracts (Acyclic DAG)
infra/ & .github/ — Infrastructure, Cloud (QA & PROD), Security & ODD Observability
